text: Train was very clean, punctual and arrived 15 mins before time. Excellent journey!
Extremely dirty coaches, cockroaches everywhere and toilets stinking terribly.
Pantry food was absolutely delicious and served hot. Attendants were very polite.
Terrible food, gave me severe food poisoning. Stale, cold and unhygienic.
AC was chilling properly, berths were wide and peaceful overnight journey.
AC not working for the entire 12 hour journey. Suffocating and unbearable heat.
Train delayed by over 6 hours without any explanation or announcement.
Superfast express running at high speed and reached destination on right time.
Charging points were functional and water was available in washrooms throughout.
No water in taps, charging sockets completely broken. Pathetic maintenance.
TTE was extremely polite and helped my elderly parents find their lower berths.
Staff was rude, demanding extra bribes for seats. Worst customer service.
Average train, nothing special. Left on time, reached 30 minutes late.
Bedrolls provided were fresh and neatly sealed in plastic covers.
Dirty torn blankets smelling of diesel and dust. Completely unhygienic.
Vande Bharat experience was top notch. Fast, quiet and spotless coaches.
Catering tea was cold and breakfast omelette tasted rubbery.
Clean toilets with soap dispensers full. Pleasant surprise for Indian Railways.
Crowded sleeper coach with unreserved passengers blocking passageways and doors.
RPF security patrolling regularly. Felt very safe traveling solo as a woman.
Train halted at outer signal for 2 hours just outside destination station.
Smooth and steady run. Very comfortable for senior citizens.
Coach floor was wet and garbage overflowing near the washbasins.
Pantry staff served fresh vegetable biryani with curd and pickle. Tasty.
Charging socket had loose wiring and almost sparked while charging laptop.
Decent journey, coaches were cleaned once at an intermediate junction.
Train had standard ICF coaches. Typical squeaking noises and normal travel.
LHB coach ride was very smooth with minimal jerks and good sound insulation.
Windows were opaque from outside dust and dirt. Could not view the scenery.
Breakfast poha and upma were fresh and reasonably priced at 40 rupees.
Severe delay of 8 hours due to fog. Understandable weather circumstances.
Cleanest train on this route. Housekeeping staff swept the floor twice.
Coach attendant was sleeping and refused to provide bedroll until yelled at.
Quick turnaround time and prompt departure from every halt.
Broken armrest and non-reclining chair car seat. Very uncomfortable.
Clean linen, well-mannered staff, on-time arrival. Worth the ticket price.
Water ran out in the western toilet after just 3 hours into the trip.
No catering pantry car attached on this route. Bring your own food.
Great speed! Covered 500 km in under 6 hours without any unscheduled stops.
Rats running across the floor in First AC. Unacceptable for premium fare.
Staff distributed complimentary water bottles promptly upon boarding.
Coach was freezing cold, AC cooling could not be regulated by staff.
Standard second sitting journey, moderately clean and reasonably on time.
Washroom door latch was broken and could not be locked from inside.
Clean curtains, warm blankets, and spotless charging points. 5 stars.
Pantry vendor overcharged 20 rupees above MRP on rail neer water bottles.
Punctual express, arrived exactly at 07:00 AM as printed on the chart.
Horrible stinking bio-toilets and dry water tanks throughout the night.
Cooperative TTE allotted side-lower berth to senior citizen passenger.
Overall satisfactory ride. Timely departures with clean bedding.
